article.story: Boston College (4-3) at Duke (5-2), Oct. 31 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Duke by 7. Against the spread: Duke 5-2, Boston College 5-2. How to watch: The CW Key stats Duke Offense Overall: 426.1 yards per game (40th in FBS) Passing: 236.4 yards per game (61st) Rushing: 189.7 yards per game (37th) Scoring: 29.9 points per game (62nd) Duke Defense Overall: 301.3 yards per game (22nd in FBS) Passing: 194.1 yards per game (41st) Rushing: 107.1 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 16.0 points per game (17th) Boston College Offense Overall: 375.7 yards per game (81st in FBS) Passing: 194.7 yards per game (103rd) Rushing: 181.0 yards per game (45th) Scoring: 24.4 points per game (96th) Boston College Defense Overall: 333.3 yards per game (47th in FBS) Passing: 182.1 yards per game (27th) Rushing: 151.1 yards per game (85th) Scoring: 23.6 points per game (63rd) Boston College is 90th in third down percentage, converting 37.5% of the time. Duke ranks 9th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 29.2%. Duke is 115th in the FBS with 70.0 penalty yards per game. Boston College is 134th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 66.7% of trips. Duke's red zone defense ranks 64th at 83.3%. Team leaders Duke Passing: Walker Eget, 1,440 yards, 8 TDs, 3 INTs, 61.9 completion percentage Rushing: Nate Sheppard, 875 yards on 153 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Jonah Burton, 289 yards on 20 catches, 1 TD Boston College Passing: Mason McKenzie, 1,363 yards, 8 TDs, 7 INTs, 58.5 completion percentage Rushing: McKenzie, 614 yards on 119 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Javarius Green, 286 yards on 26 catches, 1 TD Last game Duke won 19-16 over Virginia on Oct. 23. Eget passed for 211 yards on 14-of-25 attempts (56.0%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Sheppard carried the ball 15 times for 55 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for 11 yards. Burton put up 59 yards on four catches. Boston College defeated Georgia Tech 49-27 on Oct. 24. McKenzie led Boston College with 101 yards on 9-of-17 passing (52.9%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 16 times for 170 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Bo MacCormack III had 155 rushing yards on 20 carries and three touchdowns, adding two receptions for 13 yards. Green recorded 57 yards on three catches. Next game Duke plays at NC State on Nov. 7. Boston College hosts Florida State on Nov. 7.
